rules.title: RSO Annual Allowable Rent Increase (July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026)
rules.requirement: For rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, the annual allowable rent increase effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%

rules.title: RSO Elimination of Additional Utility Percentage Increase
rules.requirement: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord of an RSO unit can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.

rules.title: Advance Notice of Rent Increases
rules.requirement: Landlords must provide 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
rules.key_value: 30 days' written notice for increases of less than 10%
rules.coverage_text: Landlords raising rent by less than 10%.
rules.citation: State law (as summarized by the Los Angeles Housing Department)
rules.quoted_span: State law requires landlords to provide 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
